title: Rav Hamnuna Zuta or Zuti
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: A precious prayer of his remains to us, as in Berakhot 17a, which he used to say: “My God, before I was formed I was unworthy, and now that I have been formed it is as though I had not been formed; I am dust in my life, all the more so in my death,” etc. There, at 31a, the Rabbis said to Rav Hamnuna Zuti at the wedding of Mar son of Ravina, “Let the Master sing for us.” He said: “Woe to us, for we shall die; woe to us, for we shall die.” They said to him: “What shall we respond after you?” He said: “Where is the Torah and where is the mitzvah that will protect us?”

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot 17a gives the prayer after Rava’s prayer service and identifies it as Rav Hamnuna Zuti’s confession on Yom Kippur. This shared wording does not identify the two speakers. Berakhot 31a directly names Hamnuna Zuti in the wedding exchange.
